rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for physical thickness, including a stated measurement.

example.english: This wooden board is two inches thick.
example.jyutping: ni1 faai3 muk6 baan2 jau5 loeng5 cyun3 hau5

rows.note: Use this for liquids or sauces that are thick and viscous rather than watery.

example.english: This sauce is too thick, so I can't mix it evenly.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zap1 taai3 git6 laa3 lou1 m4 wan4

rows.note: Use this for vegetation or other things that are densely packed.

example.english: The trees in this forest grow very thick.
example.traditional: 呢片樹林啲樹生得好茂密。
example.jyutping: ni1 pin3 syu6 lam4 di1 syu6 saang1 dak1 hou2 mau6 mat6

rows.note: Use this with 口音 for an accent that is strongly marked or difficult to understand.

example.english: Their Cantonese accent is so thick that I often can't understand them.
example.traditional: 佢講廣東話口音好重，我成日聽唔明。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 gwong2 dung1 waa2 hau2 jam1 hou2 cung5 ngo5 sing4 jat6 teng1 m4 ming4
